AMD FidelityFX SDK 2.3.0 (github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK, commit 60f4ea8):
the FSR 1 and FSR 3 upscaler GPU sources and the core headers they include, listed in the SDK's
docs/license.md as subject to this license.
Changed here: two includes of ffx_core.h by the SDK tree's relative path name it on the include path, and the callbacks header gives its storage images their formats
for SPIR-V (FFX_TDKR_IMAGE_FORMAT).
